producer_definition: Real SongCore artifact + real FFmpeg seek/decode: flac-16-44-stereo fixture with three frame BODY bits flipped (73_502/77_042/80_375 ^= 1; headers intact), seek 2.0s lands on the first corrupt body; ProviderSeekOutcome::MutatedThenFailed('could not reach a landing point'); post-seek read_frames returns the real DecodeError 'decode error'; emit_decode_fault emits a class-alpha diagnostic record. No upper-layer DecodeError is fabricated.

C1.name: BLOCKED_SINK
C1.PREMISE: Fresh process. A helper thread holds the real process-wide std stderr lock (lock-acquired condvar witness) and the sole drainer is synchronously inside the real StderrExporter write (seed beta record; entered mpsc witness; beta_consumed>=1; in_export=true). The producer is the real decode-seek fault above on the alpha-registered test thread. QIANQIAN_FFMPEG_LOG=1.
C1.PRODUCER_PROGRESS: The producer returned in 1 ms while the sink remained blocked: finished_while_held=true, sink_still_blocked=true (final green). No producer backpressure on the blocked sink.
C1.RELIABLE_RESULT: seek -> ProviderSeekOutcome::MutatedThenFailed {"could not reach a landing point"}; post-seek read_frames -> DecodeError {"decode error"}.
C1.TERMINAL_OUTCOME: The post-seek DecodeError is the terminal reliable Class-A outcome observed; the failed seek does not itself latch a fatal status in the production path. Stream drop completes (drop -> song_close). No wider terminal claim is made.
C1.TEARDOWN_OUTCOME: After the producer-side observations the helper sets released=true and releases the real stderr lock; the drainer resumes and shutdown(5s) reports drained=true, abandoned=false, undelivered_at_exit=0.
C1.LOSS_ACCOUNTING: alpha attempted=8, accepted=2, rejected=6 (attempted=accepted+rejected). At the blocked instant alpha_rejected=6, copied_out=2; after release exported=3 (seed + two admitted records), export_failed=0; identity copied_out+beta_consumed(1)=exported(3)+export_failed(0). The seek-fault record itself was rejected at the two-slot pool and counted (best-effort); the same record's delivery is separately proved in C4 via the beta producer.
C1.COUNTERFACTUAL: Mutation: emit_decode_fault synchronously calls qianqian_diagnostics::write_stderr_line before emit (producer coupled to the blocked sink). Result: finished_while_held=false, elapsed_ms=9996; precise RED at 'C1 ISOLATION: the producer returned only after the blocked sink was released' (test result FAILED, exit 101, no build error, no watchdog kill). Source restored byte-for-byte (sha256 08eee845...) and the cell reran GREEN.
C1.ENVIRONMENT: linux x86_64 (WSL2 kernel 6.18.54.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2), rustc/cargo 1.97.1, artifact a0a3baf8..., FFmpeg n9.0.1 pinned closure, QIANQIAN_FFMPEG_LOG=1. Windows native: NOT_RUN (#172 artifact precondition unmet).
C1.VERDICT: PASS (linux-x86_64 host-native only). Windows native NOT_RUN.

C2.name: STOPPED_CONSUMER
C2.PREMISE: Fresh process. The sole drainer is seeded into the real export call and then waits on a test-owned gate that is never released (entered mpsc witness; the consumer is stopped and provably inside the exporter). The real decode-seek producer then runs on the alpha-registered test thread.
C2.PRODUCER_PROGRESS: The producer returned in 1 ms with the consumer stopped; no producer wait on the dead consumer.
C2.RELIABLE_RESULT: seek -> MutatedThenFailed {"could not reach a landing point"}; post-seek read_frames -> DecodeError {"decode error"}.
C2.TERMINAL_OUTCOME: Same post-seek DecodeError; stream drop completes. No claim that the stopped drainer observed anything.
C2.TEARDOWN_OUTCOME: shutdown(50ms) returned in 50 ms with drained=false, abandoned=true, undelivered_at_exit=3. The stopped exporter is intentionally never released; process exit is cleanup, not a join/quiescence claim.
C2.LOSS_ACCOUNTING: alpha attempted=8, accepted=2, rejected=6, outstanding=2; exported=0 (nothing delivered while stopped); beta_queued=1/beta_consumed=1 in flight; undelivered_at_exit=3 = two alpha pool records + one beta record consumed by the drainer but not exported. Abandoned records are never written as delivered.
C2.COUNTERFACTUAL: Mutation: the shutdown deadline branch reports drained=true, abandoned=false instead of abandoned=true. Result: precise RED at 'C2 HONEST-ACCOUNTING: a stopped drainer must NEVER be reported drained' (ShutdownReport printed with drained=true, abandoned=false, undelivered_at_exit=3; test result FAILED, exit 101). Source restored byte-for-byte (sha256 98891d1d...) and the cell reran GREEN.
C2.ENVIRONMENT: linux x86_64 (WSL2), artifact a0a3baf8..., FFmpeg n9.0.1, QIANQIAN_FFMPEG_LOG=1. Windows native: NOT_RUN (#172).
C2.VERDICT: PASS (linux-x86_64 host-native only). Windows native NOT_RUN.

C3.name: CAPACITY_EXHAUSTION
C3.PREMISE: Fresh process. The sole drainer is stopped in the real export call (same HeldExporter seam as C2). On the alpha-registered producer thread the current two-slot pool is filled by the real producer until the first AlphaRejected proves the bound: fill accepted=2, first rejection observed, pool_full_seen=true.
C3.PRODUCER_PROGRESS: The real decode-seek producer then ran and returned in 1 ms; every record it emitted after the fill was rejected at the full pool: rejected 1->9, accepted unchanged at 2, outstanding stays 2 (the pool bound). No unbounded block and no growth beyond two slots.
C3.RELIABLE_RESULT: seek -> MutatedThenFailed {"could not reach a landing point"}; post-seek read_frames -> DecodeError {"decode error"}. The reliable results are unchanged by admission loss.
C3.TERMINAL_OUTCOME: Same post-seek DecodeError; stream drop completes.
C3.TEARDOWN_OUTCOME: shutdown(50ms) returned bounded with drained=false, abandoned=true, undelivered_at_exit=3 (stopped consumer).
C3.LOSS_ACCOUNTING: alpha attempted=11, accepted=2, rejected=9; alpha_rejected counter=9; outstanding=2; attempted=accepted+rejected. The beta channel is structurally not on this producer's path: the decode worker is alpha-registered, and emit returns after the pool publish attempt (no beta fallback). Allocation boundedness is structural: pool.rs publish is a single bounded attempt into two preallocated slots with no loop/CAS/lock/allocation; no allocation counter is claimed.
C3.COUNTERFACTUAL: Mutation: remove the full-pool rejection branch in pool.rs (publish keeps accepting/overwriting). Result: fill accepted=3 with pool_full_seen=false; after the real producer accepted=11, rejected=0, outstanding=11; precise RED at 'C3 ISOLATION: the real producer's records were rejected at the full alpha pool' (test result FAILED, exit 101). Source restored byte-for-byte (sha256 9f923666...) and the cell reran GREEN.
C3.ENVIRONMENT: linux x86_64 (WSL2), artifact a0a3baf8..., FFmpeg n9.0.1, QIANQIAN_FFMPEG_LOG=1. Windows native: NOT_RUN (#172).
C3.VERDICT: PASS (linux-x86_64 host-native only). Windows NOT_RUN; beta-queue exhaustion for an unregistered producer is outside this arm's producer definition (structural note, not counted as coverage).

C4.name: WRITE_FAILURE
C4.PREMISE: Fresh process with a switchable exporter. Healthy phase: the real alpha producer and a second real producer on an UNREGISTERED thread (beta channel) both yield the same reliable results; the beta-delivered record carries (status 110, native AVERROR_INVALIDDATA) from the producer's own site. Then the exporter is switched to return a real ExportError on every export.
C4.PRODUCER_PROGRESS: The failing-phase real producer returned with the same reliable results; alpha attempted=16, accepted=6, rejected=10 (totals; admitted count varies with drainer interleaving), attempted=accepted+rejected.
C4.RELIABLE_RESULT: Failing-phase seek diagnostic and post-seek DecodeError are byte-identical to the healthy phase: "could not reach a landing point" / "decode error".
C4.TERMINAL_OUTCOME: Same post-seek DecodeError; export failure never changes the reliable decode result.
C4.TEARDOWN_OUTCOME: shutdown(5s) reports drained=true, abandoned=false, undelivered_at_exit=0; exactly one exporter-disable self-diagnostic; the failing exporter is disabled, not a stopped consumer.
C4.LOSS_ACCOUNTING: Final green: export_failed=4 (2-4 across runs, depending on how many admitted records the drainer attempted before the disable), exported frozen at 4, self_diagnostics=1; identity copied_out(6)+beta_consumed(2)=exported(4)+export_failed(4). No failed record is counted as delivered.
C4.COUNTERFACTUAL: Mutation: zero both export_failed increments in the deliver path. Result: export_failed stays 0 (before=0 after=0) while records were admitted and the exporter failed; precise RED at 'C4 LOSS-ACCOUNTING: the failed export attempts are counted as export_failed' (test result FAILED, exit 101). Source restored byte-for-byte (sha256 98891d1d...) and the cell reran GREEN.
C4.ENVIRONMENT: linux x86_64 (WSL2), artifact a0a3baf8..., FFmpeg n9.0.1, QIANQIAN_FFMPEG_LOG=1. Windows native: NOT_RUN (#172).
C4.VERDICT: PASS (linux-x86_64 host-native only). Windows native NOT_RUN.
